'''Dimity''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] who worked for the [[Security Police/Legends|Espos]] at [[Mondder Spaceport]] on [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]].

==Biography==
In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], he was with [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Myrsk]] when they broke up a brawl between [[Jahan Cross]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and a group of disgruntled [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] patrons. He loaded the criminals into a waiting [[JX40 Jailspeeder]].<ref name="AotE1">[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 1|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 1]]</ref> Later, he was present when Cross was arrested for the murder of [[Dah'lis Stark]].<ref name="AotE2">[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 2|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 2]]</ref>.

After Cross crashed a speeder during his escape from the [[Stark Compound]], he suggested that it was possible that the Imperial agent's body was blown to bits by the explosion. His partner Myrsk didn't think this was likely and took Dimity as backup to the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] while he questioned Solo. When Myrsk punched Solo and was confronted by an angry Chewbacca, Dimity stood by and watched without intervening. After they departed the ship, Myrsk asked why he didn't help, and Dimity responded that it was "above my pay grade."

He was with Myrsk as they staked out the [[Hangar/Legends|landing bay]] where the ''Falcon'' was docked, since Myrsk was certain that Cross would eventually turn up. Dimity suggested that Cross might find other ways off the planet, but Myrsk dismissed this idea. When a [[Ambassador Vorlin's private shuttle|shuttle]] was reported stolen from the Imperial embassy, Dimity was proven correct. He piloted the airspeeder designated ''Espo Ground One'' as Myrsk coordinated the attempt to prevent the stolen shuttle from escaping. When the shuttle crashed into a [[Hovertrain/Legends|mag-lev train]], causing massive damage, Dimity examined the crash site with Myrsk. Due to the extensive damage, Dimity stated that he was sure Myrsk would get into serious trouble. Myrsk agreed, but stated that he intended to take full responsibility for it but would then shift all the blame to Dimity.<ref name="AotE3">[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 3|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 3]]</ref>

==Characteristics==
Dimity was very tall and well-built, and could easily pick up an [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] with one arm. He also sported short blonde [[Hair/Legends|hair]].
